queries: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS source_size FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - sb.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS sb WHERE ss.source_size > sb.avg_size

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS source_size FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - sb.avg_size) AS avg_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN size_baseline AS sb WHERE ss.source_size > sb.avg_size

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(source_size * 1.0) AS average_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.average_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - b.average_size) AS average_excess_size FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE ss.source_size > b.average_size;

WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(CAST(s.boxy AS numeric) / NULLIF(CAST(s.boxz AS numeric), 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), sized AS (SELECT source_stats.*, AVG(source_size) OVER () AS avg_source_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(source_size - avg_source_size) AS avg_size_excess FROM sized WHERE source_size > avg_source_size

assumptions.assumption: Size means the number of spatial scan records for a funding source. A missing funding source forms one group. Ratios with a missing value or zero boxz are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Size means the number of distinct projects with spatial scan data for each funding source.
